final_message:
I parsed the `workspace/worker.log` file to extract error entries based on the specified criteria. I focused on log entries with levels of ERROR, SEVERE, or FATAL, converting timestamps to UTC format. For each relevant entry, I captured the service name, formatted the level in uppercase, and extracted the message after the last `|` separator. I also calculated the `repeat_count` by summing the occurrences of the entry and any subsequent "last message repeated N times" lines.

The resulting JSON file `workspace/errors.json` contains an array of error objects and a summary of counts by service. The structure adheres to the Acme log-triage conventions.
